title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:

We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

* Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture
* Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents
* Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor
* Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service
* Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features
* Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load
* Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe
* Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt
* Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

* 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience
* Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture
* Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up
* Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them
* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline
* AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside — review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for.
* End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment
* A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved
* Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling

**Why You'll Love Us**

* We’ve evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences: We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.

We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Be Doing**

* Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online.
* Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work.
* Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need.
* Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world.

**Tech Stack**

* Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments.
* Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing.
* Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines.
* Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage.
* Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling.
* Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets.
* Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage.
* Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups.
* Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing.

**You’re Our Person If…**

* You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams.
* You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data.
* You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines.
* You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid.
* You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers.
* You are a great "service owner," meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly.

**Even Better If…**

* You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs).
* You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones.
* You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems.

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

At Aristocrat, we are committed to crafting world-class gaming experiences that engage players worldwide. Our mission is to bring happiness to life by unlocking the potential of play. As a Technical Lead, you will have a key role in reaching this goal. Our studio culture values quality, personal ownership, and a collaborative atmosphere, making this a highly rewarding opportunity for dedicated developers.
  
  
In this role, you will take charge of developing casino games for a variety of cabinets and regions. This position presents the challenge of combining intricate art, game mathematics, and regulatory requirements, offering a varied and engaging experience with every game you create. Your efforts will directly influence our capacity to bring high-quality games to various markets effectively.
  
  
What You'll Do

* Analyze game requirements in collaboration with technical leads and game designers
* Build slot games tailored to multiple cabinets and markets
* Engage in coding, code reviews, unit testing, memory profiling, and other code hygiene processes
* Ensure game quality and timely delivery to market
* Collaborate with a dedicated team of artists, game designers, developers, and test engineers
* Continuously improve processes and contribute to a culture of excellence
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues to maintain flawless game performance
* Implement new features and improvements in existing games
* Keep up-to-date with industry trends and integrate guidelines into game development
* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior developers

What We're Looking For

* At least 5 years of experience in software development
* Outstanding programming skills in C++ under Windows and Linux operating systems
* Strong skills in object-oriented development, algorithms, and data structures
* Demonstrated knowledge of the software development life cycle and engineering concepts
* A degree in Computer Science (B Tech/BE/MCA) or equivalent experience
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts
* Experience in game development is a plus
* Passion for delivering high-quality, innovative gaming experiences

Join Aristocrat, where your expertise will contribute to crafting flawless casino games that entertain millions of players worldwide!
